originating_session_goal: Govern the VA Claims Guide and VA Claims Chat, add private document loading and analysis comparable to modern conversational document workspaces, and progress toward automated claim filing from veteran-uploaded records.

product_surfaces.name: GOVERNED_VA_CLAIMS_GUIDE
product_surfaces.purpose: Provide an evidence-grounded, current, source-cited claim workflow whose displayed guidance and capability status are governed by machine-verifiable receipts.
required_capabilities: clear separation of educational guidance from legal, medical, representative, adjudicative, and filing authority
product_surfaces.release_condition: A guide governance receipt validates source policy, displayed capability claims, authority boundaries, and current activation state with blockers empty.

product_surfaces.name: GOVERNED_VA_CLAIMS_CHAT
product_surfaces.purpose: Provide a conversational VA claim workspace for procedural questions, evidence organization, drafting assistance, document-grounded analysis, uncertainty tracking, and veteran-controlled session continuity.
required_capabilities: draft generation limited to veteran-confirmed facts
product_surfaces.release_condition: A deployed governed chat session proves document-grounded execution, custody, reconstruction, privacy boundaries, false authority flags, and an accurate public capability projection.

product_surfaces.name: PRIVATE_CLAIM_DOCUMENT_WORKSPACE
product_surfaces.purpose: Allow veterans to upload claim-related documents and receive organized, source-bound analysis with features and benefits comparable to a capable conversational document workspace while adding StegVerse governance, custody, replay, and authority controls.
required_capabilities: document identity hashes and page anchors
privacy classification retention and deletion controls
product_surfaces.release_condition: Private upload, analysis, retention, deletion, export, custody, and reconstruction paths are directly validated and public upload remains disabled until every required gate is verified.

product_surfaces.name: VETERAN_APPROVED_AUTOMATED_CLAIM_FILING
product_surfaces.purpose: Progress from uploaded records to a proposed claim package and eventually to filing through an authorized channel, without transferring final factual confirmation, consent, signature, or submission authority away from the veteran unless an independently valid delegation exists.
stages: derive candidate conditions and claim theories from admitted records
build evidence indexes timelines contradiction lists and missing-evidence tasks
draft forms and supporting statements without inventing facts
present a complete veteran-review packet and change log
require explicit veteran confirmation of each material fact and claimed condition
run pre-submission validation against current official requirements
obtain a specific unexpired submission authorization receipt
submit only through an authorized VA or accredited-representative integration
retain submission confirmation custody reconstruction and revocation evidence
prohibited_shortcuts: invented diagnoses events nexus severity dates or signatures
credential collection or browser automation outside an authorized integration
claiming representation accreditation adjudication medical opinion or VA authority
optimizing for a target disability percentage rather than evidentiary accuracy
product_surfaces.release_condition: Automated filing remains unavailable until legal and platform authority, identity, consent, signature, form accuracy, submission-channel authorization, revocation, custody, reconstruction, and post-submission confirmation gates are all VERIFIED.

next_executable_actions.action: Project the governed Guide and Chat roadmap and current verified capability without presenting future upload or filing capabilities as active.
Implement admitted private multi-document sessions, source-bound outputs, privacy controls, export packets, and execution receipts.
Expand governed routing and answer generation beyond the current bounded public-source route while retaining fail-closed unsupported routes.
Define identity consent signature preflight submission and confirmation gates before any automated filing implementation is activated.
